title: "HPA brain data"
author: "Beth Ravilious"
---
I am calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (Cerebral cortex, Basal ganglia, Thalamus, Hypothalamus) for Humans, Pigs and Mice.
```{r}
print(paste("Human", sum(180, 83, 57, 110)))
print(paste("Pig", sum(109, 157, 31, 45)))
print(paste("Mouse", sum(55, 185, 60, 98)))
```
In conclusion, Humans had the greatest number of genes with regionally elevated expression followed by Pigs and then Mice.
